summary: BOSUN AS (org. no. 922 820 473) is a private limited company (AS) based in Haugesund, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2019-05-29. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 68.110 (Kjøp og salg av egen fast eiendom). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 305 240 and net income was NOK 49 384. CEO: Harald Frette Litlehamar; board chair: Harald Frette Litlehamar.
